name: Ana Friedman
purpose: Wave3 intrinsic topic authoring proposal. Does not establish a meeting with V, a save outcome, or shared conversational memory.

sourcePolicy.primary: Current installed native resources, fresh pinned serialization and hashes. Typed codex subject/title, actor-to-screenplay speaker, dialog events, exact en_us descriptor/payload and same-ID shipped English variants.
sourcePolicy.nativeNarrative: Codex narrator judgments are attributed descriptions; self-reports retain their viewpoint. Branch-specific dialogue establishes available authored speech only, not the loaded save outcome.
sourcePolicy.privacy: Operational secrets, relationship details and crime allegations remain private. Conditional endings are excluded from universal public topic authoring.
sourcePolicy.examples: Original editorial delivery examples, not game quotations. No speaker-name prefixes, fabricated V encounters or synthetic memory seeding.
sourcePolicy.promotion: Proposal only; compiler owner independently qualifies native subject aliases and reviews semantics before adoption.

nativeSubjectAlternatives.use: Primary typed subject/title binding; native spelling and encoding retained.

claims.text: Ana is an analyst who has worked for the Federative Republic of Brazil's intelligence agency for several years.

limits: Professional role and broad tenure; no fabricated start year, rank, citizenship or combat training.

claims.text: Her work includes analyzing movements of hostile corporations in the NUSA.

limits: Analyst knowledge, not field experience, hacking certification, weapons expertise or omniscient access to every corporation.

claims.text: The journal says Ana values the adrenaline of her work and seeing its consequences in the next day's news.

limits: Narrator-supported preference; do not claim every operation succeeds or that a specific news report appeared in this save.

claims.text: Ana describes herself as an analyst without fieldwork clearance or experience.

limits: Her own stated professional limitation. Knowing another agent's cyberware specifications is not proof of her own combat training or implant-engineering expertise.

claims.text: The journal describes Ana as trying to forget a failed marriage.

limits: Private narrator-provided history. The text does not identify the spouse or establish legal divorce, present marital status, remarriage, children, or that Steven is that spouse.

claims.text: Ana calls Bana a dear friend and expresses concern about checking his signal.

limits: Ana's own loyalty and friendship, not a verified survival/death finding, childhood history or proof V accepted the assignment.

claims.text: In a closing exchange, Ana accuses the agency of betraying Bana and a corporation of killing him.

limits: An accusation from Ana's viewpoint, not independently established universal fact.
Do not reveal private crime allegations to a group, assume Bana's fate before the qualified exchange, or seed memory of V returning evidence.

requiredContext: Current-save source-qualified quest context establishes that V reached and heard this specific Spy in the Jungle return exchange.

claims.text: In one closing branch, Ana says she plans to bring the story to the media and the agency despite efforts to silence it.

limits: Intent in authored branch dialogue; not proof the publication happened, that Steven agreed, or that V selected this outcome.

requiredContext: Current-save source-qualified quest context establishes the branch in which Ana received the evidence and stated this publication plan.
